scope: Stage-2 authority, pinned repository tree, README, exact license, exact requirements, Allen-Cahn notebook source, Lorenz source, two Kuramoto-Sivashinsky sources and Navier-Stokes source were inspected statically. Bundled data and animations were identified only by path. No environment, dependency, model, training, inference, evaluation, dataset, notebook, media, accelerator or scientific workload was executed.

unresolved_findings.finding: Stage 2 asserts no Atlas-paper relationship for CR000200; none is inferred.
The CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 license and separate patent/noncommercial warning are preserved without interpretation of their legal interaction.
README says code and data are available upon request while the pinned tree bundles benchmark code, data and animations.
The requirements file pins packages exactly but supplies no Python version or documented installation command.
All four data-driven entrypoints reference paths that do not match the bundled data/ locations at the pinned tree layout.
NS/NS.py contains a bare undefined example_libraries expression and uses optimizers without importing it, blocking the entrypoint as written.
The original hardware and accelerator environment are not specified.
Bundled animations provide qualitative historical results, but immutable numerical targets, acceptance thresholds and reusable trained checkpoints are unavailable; no outputs were revalidated.

notes: Four benchmark families are represented as four experiments; simple and chaotic Kuramoto-Sivashinsky are separate configurations.
One explicit source conflict is preserved for the data-availability statement.
